BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE VISHAL DHAGAT  ON THE 18 th OF OCTOBER, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 44568 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 VIKASH S/O SHRI NARENDRA SINGH RAJPOOT, AGED  ABOUT 22 YEARS, OCCUPATION: SELF EMPLOYED R/O  MANDLA HANUMAN MANDIR GALI PS MOOND  DISTRICT KHANDWA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI RAJMANI MISHRA, ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION MOONDI DISTRICT KHANDWA (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI S. K. SHRIVASTAVA, GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is third application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail to applicant who is in custody since 15.10.2022 relating to FIR No.432/2022,
registered at Police Station-Moondi, District-Khandwa (MP) for the offence punishable under Section 306, 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5, 5(L) and 6 of POCSO Act.
2.
Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is a young man aged about 22 years.
He was married.
There was extra marital affair of applicant with the deceased.
She was also a married lady.
She has lodged FIR against the applicant in which there was compromise as applicant promised to marry her.
However, there was no divorce of applicant.
In these circumstances applicant could not marry the deceased on account of which she committed suicide.
Applicant is in jail since last one year.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.
It is submitted that deceased was also a young married woman aged about 22 years.
Earlier also FIR has been lodged by the deceased against the applicant.
This is second FIR lodged against the applicant.
Due to act of applicant, she has committed suicide.
Positive act on part of applicant led to suicide.
In these circumstances he may not be released on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Applicant is in jail since 5.10.2022 for about one year.
He is a young man aged about 22 years.

Deceased was a married woman aged about 22 years.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the period of custody of applicant, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
7 . It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

8 . In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE mms Vikash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193693274/
